data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘Ayn, meaning 'eye'. In Islamic tradition, the name Ayan symbolizes the ability to observe, understand, and learn from the world around us, with the wisdom and insight of the eyes of the heart. The name Ayan also holds spiritual significance, as it is mentioned in the Quran in the context of the Day of Judgment, where the righteous are described as those who will be given 'eyes' with which to see and understand the signs of Allah.
